Certified integration partner program
Being a partner has its perks
Want to become a certified integration partner?
Certified integrations are built with both the recruiter and the candidate in mind. Becoming a certified partner means that we will work together to ensure the best possible integration user experience to create a more meaningful and lasting relationship with our shared customers.
Why you should be a certified partner:
Hirevue works with 40% of the Fortune 50 Most Admired and 33% of the Fortune 100 organisations
Ensure an easy to use and streamlined workflow that is inclusive of all the great features that both Hirevue and your organisation have to offer
Certified integrations will enhance your brand equity
